**Assertion (A) :** If probability of happening of an event is \(0.2p\), \(p > 0\), then p can't be more than 5.

**Reason (R) :** \(P(\overline{E}) = 1 - P(E)\) for an event E.

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.text: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.

options.label: D
